name: Brad Poole
title: Director, User Research
quote: Ji-Sook has the uncommon ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and she has the drive to move between those levels to push the UX forward. Equally impressive was her proactive mindset. She didn't wait for problems to arise; instead, she identified opportunities for improvement early on and took the initiative, whether it was optimizing design processes within technical limitations, leading workshops, or mentoring junior designers.
